summary: In stui the opened alerts above the message box read as a pane: a filled title bar (N alerts, hide), a coloured bar down each alert, a thin rule between alerts, and notes wrapped instead of cut off at the edge, with room for up to half the conversation so the answer buttons stay in view

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. stui only.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
